note: Encyclopedia biography. It names Marshall Field's children and grandchildren; it does not give the Prairie Avenue addresses (the Blue Book does) or Gwendolyn Field's birth date. Fragments read: 'Give the lady what she wants'; 'the wealthiest and most powerful businessman in Chicago', his fortune valued at $125 million in 1905; his son Marshall Field Jr. shot on 22 November 1905, the cause still uncertain; Field himself died of pneumonia in New York on 16 January 1906, caught after a New Year's Day golf game with, among others, Robert Todd Lincoln; buried at Graceland.
